findings.summary: crates/setup/src/lib.rs:56: scrub() redacts only key lines longer than 16 characters, so if kubectl's stderr ever echoes the merge patch on a failed `patch secret`, the PEM's short last base64 line (and any base64 or other re-encoded form of the key) is printed in the error. Only a few characters of the key could leak and the server would have to echo the body, but the AC-5 promise rests on this filter. Redact every non-armor line, or better, don't print stderr from the patch call at all.

decision: Open the PR and advance to PR review
